How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

  1. How many customers does OpenText have in total, and how many use the product under review?

  2. Has OpenText lost any large financial-services customers of the product under review in the last three years, and why?

Timeline

  1. 2026-06-04 · launch OpenText
    OpenText adds Capture Aviator, an LLM-based document understanding add-on

    OpenText's release-history post dated 2026-06-04 describes Capture Aviator in release CE 26.2 (June 2026): an add-on for OpenText Capture and Core Capture that applies large language model extraction to hard documents such as complex tables, handwriting and low-quality scans, with the model accessed through OpenText rather than a separate AI licence. The same release adds monitoring metrics exposed through OpenTelemetry and OpenMetrics endpoints.     OpenText Application Security 26.2 adds support for Aviator auto-remediation

    The What's New document for OpenText Application Security Software 26.2, dated 2026-05-14, describes support for Aviator auto-remediation (AI-generated code fix suggestions stored per issue), built-in Aviator tag attributes, a Helm chart update for Kubernetes deployments, and new report templates for DISA STIG 6.4, OWASP Top 10 2025 and OWASP LLM Top 10 2025.
